verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents departmental budget controls, spend limits/card controls, and embedding expense policies with real-time adjustment, which supports finance leads capping spend by team/program. However, evidence is all vendor marketing copy with no detail on how budgets are scoped specifically to 'departments/programs' as a distinct construct, no proof of automatic hard-block enforcement vs soft alerts, and no independent/hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: independent verification of enforcement mechanics, explicit department/program-level budget hierarchy documentation, and confirmation limits are hard-enforced rather than advisory.
